briefdescription.para: Composable value wrapper with pluggable executor strategy.

detaileddescription.para: A wrapper<Value, Executors...> proxies method calls to the held Value through a chain of executors. Each executor is a class template that can transparently add cross-cutting properties such as copy-on-write semantics, thread safety, or deferred invocation without modifying the wrapped type. Multiple executors are composed via left-fold; adjacent duplicates are collapsed automatically.
